# 🚀 TM Executor

**Version:** 1.0.0  
Collection developed by Samuel Betancourt | GitHub: [@Leumas80](https://github.com/leumas80)

## UiPath Test Manager API — Exploratory Collection

Explore, validate, and demonstrate integration with UiPath Test Manager APIs through a structured Postman collection.

---

### Disclaimer

- UiPath Test Manager APIs, endpoints, trademarks, and related intellectual property referenced by this project remain the property of UiPath.
    
- This independently developed Postman collection is not an official UiPath product or collection.
    
- This project is intended strictly for integration and exploratory purposes and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or officially endorsed by UiPath.
    

---

### 🌐 UiPath Cloud Routing Variables

- **Organization:** Your organization name as it appears in the Automation Cloud URL.
    
    - Example: `https://cloud.uipath.com/{Organization}/...`
        
- **Tenant:** The target Tenant name (e.g., `DefaultTenant`).
    
    - Example: `https://cloud.uipath.com/{Organization}/{Tenant}/...`
        

📖 **Official Reference:** [UiPath API Endpoint URL Structure](https://docs.uipath.com/automation-cloud/automation-cloud/latest/api-guide/api-endpoint-url-structure)

---

### 📚 Documentation Sources & Swagger

- **Swagger UI:**  
    `https://cloud.uipath.com/{Organization}/{Tenant}/testmanager_/swagger/index.html`
    

📖 **Official Reference:** [UiPath Test Manager Docs](https://docs.uipath.com/test-manager/automation-cloud/latest/user-guide/test-manager-api)

# 📁 00 - Setup

This folder contains initial environment verification, authentication, and core setup requests required before executing any other collection workflows.

---

#### 🔑 TM - 00 Get Token

First mandatory step to authenticate and obtain the Bearer token needed for all subsequent requests in this collection.

- **Method & Endpoint:** `POST` `https://cloud.uipath.com/identity_/connect/token`
    
- **Body Type:** `x-www-form-urlencoded`
    
- **Required Parameters:**
    
    - `grant_type`: `client_credentials`
        
    - `client_id`: {{`ClientID`}} _(Required)_
        
    - `client_secret`: {{`ClientSecret`}} _(Required)_
        
    - `scope`: {{`Scope`}} _(Optional)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Automatically captures and saves the generated `access_token` into the {{`Token`}} collection variable.
        

📖 **Official Reference:** [UiPath External Applications Guide](https://docs.uipath.com/automation-cloud/automation-cloud/latest/api-guide/accessing-uipath-resources-using-external-applications)

---

#### 🌐 TM - 01 Get Tenant

Retrieves organization metadata and the list of active tenants associated with the current account.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Endpoint:**
    
    - `https://cloud.uipath.com/{{`Organization`}}/portal_/api/filtering/leftnav/tenantsAndOrganizationInfo`
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Displays detailed information about the organization, region, user groups, and available tenants.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the primary tenant name as {{`Tenant`}}.
        

---

#### 🩺 TM Server Information Check

Verifies the availability of the UiPath Test Manager service and retrieves basic server information.

- **Method & Endpoint:** `GET` `https://cloud.uipath.com/{{`Organization`}}/{{`Tenant`}}/testmanager_/api/serverinfo`
    
- **Output:** Returns `200 OK` with server information, including the service version, server type, and status `"OK"` when the service is operational.
    

---

#### 📁 TM - 02 Get Project Folder

Retrieves the Test Manager **Project ID** required to scope down subsequent requests (Test Cases, Test Sets, Executions, etc.).

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Parameters (OData Query):**
    
    - `$top`: Limit results _(e.g., 100)_
        
    - `$orderby`: Sorting criteria _(e.g.,_ `_updated desc_`_)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Displays the list of available projects in Test Manager.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the first project ID as {{`Test_Project`}}.

item.description:
# 🧪 01 - Test Cases

This folder contains requests focused on managing and triggering individual Test Cases within UiPath Test Manager, including fetching existing test cases and initiating single-case executions.

---

## ⚠️ Important

This collection is intended as a demonstration and execution utility for UiPath Test Manager APIs.

**Test Case selection:** For demonstration purposes, the collection automatically selects the **first Test Case** returned by the API.

If you want to execute a different Test Case, identify the desired item in the response and assign its ID to the corresponding collection variable `TestCase_ID`, or remove the Post response script that automatically assigns the first item.

---

## 🔍 TM - Get Test Cases

Retrieves the list of available Test Cases within the selected project. Use this request to inspect existing test cases and automatically extract a `TestCase_ID` for single-case executions or reporting.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        

- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
- **URL Parameters (OData Query):**
    
    - `$top`: Limit number of returned results _(e.g., 100)_
        
    - `$orderby`: Sorting criteria _(e.g.,_ `_updated desc_`_)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Returns an array of test cases with details (Name, Key, Version, etc.).
        
    - Saves the first retrieved ID into `TestCase_ID`.
        

---

## 🚀 TM - Execute Test Case

Triggers the execution of a specific Test Case directly within UiPath Test Manager.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
    - `Content-Type`: `application/json`
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
- **Request Body (raw JSON):**
    
    ``` json
      {  
      "name": "MFP:1",  
      "testCaseIds": \[ "{{`TestCase_ID`}}" \],  
      "correlationId": "{{`$guid`}}"  
      }
    
     ```
    
- **Output:**
    
    - Initiates the _Test Case_ execution in UiPath Test Manager.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the generated `ExecitionID` as a collection variable for status tracking in subsequent requests.

# 📦 02 - Test Sets

This folder contains requests focused on managing and executing Test Sets (Test Execution Containers) within UiPath Test Manager, enabling full test suite execution.

---

## ⚠️ Important

This collection is intended as a demonstration and execution utility for UiPath Test Manager APIs.

**Test Set selection:** For demonstration purposes, the collection automatically selects the **first Test Set** returned by the API.

If you want to execute a different Test Set, identify the desired item in the response and assign its ID to the corresponding collection variable `TestSet_ID`, or remove the Post response script that automatically assigns the first item.

---

## 🔍 TM - Get Test Set

Retrieves all available Test Sets within the project. Use this request to inspect test set configurations and automatically extract the `TestSet_ID` required for suite executions.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
- **URL Parameters (OData Query):**
    
    - `$orderby`: Sorting criteria _(e.g.,__**\`**__updated desc_\`_)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Displays the list of available Test Sets and their details.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the first retrieved ID as `TestSet_ID`.
        

---

## 🚀 TM - Execute Test Set

Triggers the execution of an entire Test Set within UiPath Test Manager.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
    - `Content-Type`: `application/json`
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
- **Request Body (raw JSON):**
    
    ``` json
    {  
    "correlationId": "{{`$guid`}}"  
    }
    
     ```
    
- **Output:**
    
    - Initiates the _Test Set_ execution in UiPath Test Manager.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the generated `ExecitionID` as a collection variable for status tracking in subsequent requests.

item.description:
# 📊 03 - Executions

This folder contains requests focused on querying test execution results, retrieving real-time status and logs for specific runs, and fetching project user details within UiPath Test Manager.

---
## ⚠️ Important

For demonstration purposes, the collection automatically selects the most recently finished Test Execution returned by the API.

The results are sorted by `executionFinished` in descending order, and the collection uses the first item returned to populate `ExecitionID`.

If you want to use a specific Test Execution, identify the desired execution in the response and assign its ID to the `ExecitionID` collection variable, or remove the Post-response script that performs the automatic selection.

---

## 🔍 TM - Get all Test Execution

Retrieves a complete list of test executions within the specified project. Useful for auditing, generating dashboards, or checking overall test history.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Displays a historical list of all test executions and their current status _(e.g., Passed, Failed, In Progress)_.
        

---

## 🔍 TM - Get Results by ExecutionID

Retrieves detailed information and real-time execution status for a single test run.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        

- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
    - `ExecutionID`: {{`ExecutionID`}} _(obtained when triggering a Test Case or Test Set)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Returns execution status, duration, and aggregated test results including Passed, Failed, and None counts.
        

---

## 🔍 TM - Get Owners

Retrieves the list of project members and owners available within Test Manager.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        

- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        

- **Output:**
    
    - Returns user profiles, IDs, and email addresses associated with the target project.

item.description:
# 📄 04 - Reports

This folder contains requests used to generate, track, and download PDF summary reports containing assertion details and screenshots from UiPath Test Manager.

---

#### 🛠️ 1. TM - Get PDF Result

Directly requests the PDF summary report generation for a specific Test Case or Test Set execution.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
    - `ExecutionID`: {{`ExecutionID`}} _(obtained when triggering a Test Case or Test Set)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Initiates the PDF generation background process.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the generated {{`PDF_ID`}}.
        

---

#### ⏳ 2. TM - File Export Job

Queries the asynchronous background export job status to verify report readiness and retrieve file attachment details.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
    - `id`: {{`PDF_ID`}} _(obtained in the previous step)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Returns background job status.
        
    - Automatically captures and saves the generated {{`Attachment_ID`}} when ready for download.
        

---

#### 📥 3. TM - Download PDF Report

Downloads the generated PDF execution report containing the execution results, assertion details (Pass/Fail status), and attached screenshots for a specific Test Case or Test Set run.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
    - `id`: {{`Attachment_ID`}} _(obtained in the previous step)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Downloads the binary stream (PDF or artifact file) corresponding to the specified {{`Attachment_ID`}}.

# 🏷️ 05 - Labels

This folder contains requests used to retrieve, assign, and remove labels or tags on test objects, facilitating better categorization, organization, and filtering within UiPath Test Manager.

---

#### 🔍 TM - Get Labels

Retrieves all available labels/tags defined within the project. Useful for filtering, categorization, and organizing test assets.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_
        
    - `Project-Id`: {{`Test_Project`}} _(obtained in step 02)_
        
    - `ExecutionID`: {{`ExecutionID`}} _(obtained when triggering a Test Case or Test Set)_
        
- **Output:**
    
    - Displays the collection of labels with their respective IDs, names, and assigned colors.
        

---

#### 🏷️ TM - Assign Label

Assigns a specific label to a Test Execution object.

- **Required Headers:**
    
    - `Authorization`: Bearer {{`Token`}} _(obtained in step 00)_
        
    - `Content-Type`: `application/json`
        
- **URL Path Variables:**
    
    - `Tenant`: {{`Tenant`}} _(obtained in step 01)_

# 📘 99 - How To

This section details the End-to-End (E2E) execution workflows available in this collection, explaining how requests interact sequentially to execute tests and retrieve PDF reports.

---

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Guidance

#### 🧪 Option 1: Execute a Single Test Case

1. **Authentication & Setup (`00 - Setup`):**
   - Run **🔑 TM - 00 Get Token** to fetch and store {{`Token`}}.
   - Run **🌐 TM My Organization Info** to select and save {{`Tenant`}}.
   - Run **📁 TM - Get Project** to capture and save {{`Test_Project`}}.

2. **Execution (`01 - Test Cases`):**
   - Run **🔍 TM - Get Test Cases** to fetch {{`TestCase_ID`}}.
   - Run **🚀 TM - Execute Test Case** to launch execution and receive {{`ExecutionID`}}.

3. **Tracking & Reporting (`03` & `04`):**
   - Track execution status via **📊 TM - Get Execution by ExecutionID**.
   - Generate the report using **🛠️ 1. TM - Get PDF Result** to capture {{`PDF_ID`}}.
   - Poll **⏳ 2. TM - File Export Job** until ready to capture {{`Attachment_ID`}}.
   - Download the report using **📥 3. TM - Download PDF Report**.

---

#### 📦 Option 2: Execute an Entire Test Set

1. **Authentication & Setup (`00 - Setup`):**
   - Run **🔑 TM - 00 Get Token** to fetch and store {{`Token`}}.
   - Run **🌐 TM My Organization Info** to select and save {{`Tenant`}}.
   - Run **📁 TM - Get Project** to capture and save {{`Test_Project`}}.

2. **Execution (`02 - Test Sets`):**
   - Run **🔍 TM - Get Test Set** to fetch {{`TestSet_ID`}}.
   - Run **🚀 TM - Execute Test Set** to launch execution and receive {{`ExecutionID`}}.

3. **Tracking & Reporting (`03` & `04`):**
   - Track execution status via **📊 TM - Get Execution by ExecutionID**.
   - Generate the report using **🛠️ 1. TM - Get PDF Result** to capture {{`PDF_ID`}}.
   - Poll **⏳ 2. TM - File Export Job** until ready to capture {{`Attachment_ID`}}.
   - Download the report using **📥 3. TM - Download PDF Report**.
